events.body: This is a driver-filed safety case. The driver complains that the rider threatened to punch him after he asked the rider not to smoke [F6], and the in-app chat corroborates it: at 18:21 the driver wrote “Please do not smoke in the car.” [F3], and one minute later, at 18:22, the rider replied “Say that again and I will punch you.” [F4]. The record is complete and fully timestamped [F5], so I read the rider's message as a direct threat of physical violence aimed at the driver, not as a route-argument rudeness. Ryde's code of conduct bars “Threats and Intimidation” and “abuse of any kind” and requires mandatory escalation rather than an automatic ruling [SAFE-1]. The safety screen is therefore positive and the case escalates: no fare dispute is decided here.

events.title: Notices sent to rider and driver
events.body:
RIDER: Your case has been escalated to a Ryde Trust & Safety reviewer — no decision has been made yet.

A driver raised a safety concern about your trip. The in-app chat from that trip will be looked at, along with the driver's report, and the reviewer may contact you for your side. They will also check whether a police report or a RydeHELP safety report was filed, and will decide whether any account action is needed under our code of conduct.

No fare amount is in dispute, so nothing changes with your fare or payment. Your account stays active while the review is underway.

DRIVER: Your safety report has been escalated to a Ryde Trust & Safety reviewer — no decision has been made yet.

The reviewer will look at your report, the in-app chat from the trip, and whether a police report or a RydeHELP safety report was filed. They may also contact you for more detail. Based on that, they will decide whether any action is taken on the rider's account under our code of conduct.

No fare adjustment is needed — the metered fare was within the optimal-route distance, so your earnings for this trip are unaffected. Your account stays in good standing while the review is underway.
